# OgonGo — machine-readable summary
# This file is the canonical handoff for AI agents working on an OgonGo
# project. Keep it in sync with the public package surface; if a new
# package lands, list it here. The structure intentionally mirrors the
# /agentic web convention.

# ---------- identity ----------
name: OgonGo
module: github.com/OgonFrameworks/ogon.go
version: 0.1.0-alpha
language: go
license: MIT
single-binary: ogon
config-file: ogon.yaml (walked up from cwd; env overlay ogon.<env>.yaml)
error-prefix: OGON-<class><nnnn>
error-classes: C compile | R route | V validation | K config | M migration | D dependency | S security | U runtime | G generation-conflict
exit-codes: 0 OK | 1 GenericError | 2 Usage | 3 ConfigInvalid | 4 MigrationUnsafe | 5 GenConflict | 6 TestFailure | 7 BuildFailure | 8 DoctorFailure | 130 Interrupted
purpose: A single-binary, batteries-included Go web framework. Generated DI, typed routing, realtime, jobs, auth, observability, infra-as-code. CLI owns the whole lifecycle (new, dev, build, test, deploy).

# ---------- install ----------
install: go install github.com/OgonFrameworks/ogon.go/cmd/ogon@latest
verify: ogon --version
diagnostics: ogon doctor

# ---------- CLI surface (ogon <command>) ----------
commands:
  new <name>            # scaffold a project; --template minimal|standard|modular, --db, --git, --dry-run
  dev                   # dev supervisor: watch + regen + rebuild + restart
  build                 # codegen -> fmt -> compile, stamps version
  run                   # run the built binary
  gen <thing> [name]    # generators: resource|model|route|job|auth|ui|client|openapi|test|module (supports --dry-run, --force)
  migrate <sub>         # run|rollback|status|create|diff
  db <sub>              # url|schema|reset|explain
  routes <sub>          # list|check|bench
  jobs <sub>            # list|retry|purge|run|schedule|status
  modules <sub>         # list|add|update|search
  inspect <what>        # routes|models|config|runtime|modules
  deploy                # build -> push -> apply -> verify; --cloud aws|gcp|azure; --rollback; --dry-run
  infra <sub>           # gen <target> | diff
  test [packages]       # go test + fixtures + optional junit
  lint                  # golangci-lint wrapper
  fmt                   # gofmt + gen-fmt (--fix to apply)
  check                 # CI gate: vet + gen-up-to-date + config-valid
  add <module>          # add a module or integration
  remove <module>       # remove a module (with orphan warning)
  update                # framework upgrade with AST migrations
  doctor                # env + deps + config + ports diagnostics; --fix
  explain <thing>       # explain a concept (route|model|config|di|module|component|feature|exit-codes|gen|diag)
  logs                  # tail local dev logs; --follow
  health                # hit probes, print status
  benchmark             # dx|perf suites; --suite
  docs [query]          # open or search local docs
  completion <shell>    # bash|zsh|fish|pwsh
  agent                 # machine surface: dump, serve (MCP)

global-flags: --json --no-color --yes -v/--verbose --project <dir> --version
json-envelope: {"command":"...","status":"ok|error","data":{...},"diagnostics":[...]}

# ---------- public packages and purpose ----------
packages:
  ogon              # root package — App, Boot(BootOpts), Run(ctx), Stop, Provide, Hook, State
  auth              # sessions, OAuth, passkeys, MFA, FIPS, rate-limit, lockout, PII, supply-chain
  auth/password     # argon2id password hashing + policy
  auth/session      # session manager, rotation, fixation defense
  auth/token        # JWT/OPAQUE token issue + verify
  auth/passkey      # WebAuthn / passkey enrollment
  auth/oauth        # OAuth2 providers
  authz             # RBAC, tenant scoping, policy engine
  authz/policy      # policy DSL
  cache             # pluggable cache interface
  cli               # the ogon command tree, exit codes, output envelope, suggest (did-you-mean)
  cmd/ogon          # main.go — process entrypoint; defers to cli.Execute()
  config           # ogon.yaml loader, env overlay, redact, interpolate, sources, explain
  di                # generated DI container (codegen, not reflection; manual mode available)
  diag              # structured diagnostics: Code/Title/What/Why/Where/Fix/Remedy/Docs
  fullstack         # fullstack project template
  http              # typed router, fixed middleware chain, ProblemDetails (RFC 9457), SSE/WS, sync.Pool
  infra             # docker, compose, k8s, helm, terraform, cloudflare, secrets, deploy_guides, cost
  infra/compose     # compose file generation
  infra/docker      # Dockerfile generation
  infra/k8s         # k8s manifests
  infra/helm        # helm charts
  infra/terraform   # terraform modules
  infra/cloudflare  # cloudflare bindings
  infra/actions     # GitHub Actions CI generation
  internal/diag     # internal diag helpers (not public)
  internal/errcodes # error-code tables (not public)
  internal/explain  # explain-topic registry (not public)
  jobs              # queues, retries, DLQ, idempotency, cron, outbox, workflows, tenant scoping, security
  live              # hub, channels, presence, per-message auth, backpressure, reconnect
  mcp               # machine agent surface (dump + serve)
  modules           # pluggable module manifest
  obs               # logs, traces, metrics, PII redaction, health probes, profiling, crash reporter
  pubsub            # local + redis drivers
  record            # models, migrations, RLS, audit, query builder, drivers (pgx, sqlite), scanner, raw escape
  record/types      # UUID, Decimal, JSONB, Time, Enum
  runtime           # Supervisor (goroutine ownership, panic recovery, shutdown)
  runtime/gc        # GC tuning hooks
  runtime/limits    # cgroup-aware runtime limits
  test              # in-process app fixture, recorder client, auth/db fixtures, golden, OpenAPI drift, authz matrix, playwright config, CI templates, fuzz seed registry, bench wrappers, load-script gen, redaction corpus, budget regression gate, memory-leak soak + chaos helpers
  ui                # isomorphic components, compiler, tiny JS runtime, sanitize

# ---------- key public types (entry surface) ----------
types:
  ogon.App            # root coordinator
  ogon.BootOpts       # ConfigPath, Env, Logger, Parent, DrainTimeout, DisableRuntimeLimits, Manual
  ogon.State          # New|ConfigLoaded|DIBuilt|ModulesInit|Listening|Ready|ShutdownRequested|Draining|HooksStop|Exited
  ogon.Hook           # {Name, OnStart, OnStop}
  ogon.Boot(opts) (app, err)
  app.Run(ctx) error
  app.Stop() error
  app.Provide(name, impl)        # manual DI escape hatch
  app.Provider(name) any
  app.AddStartHook(h) / AddStopHook(h)
  app.State() / app.Log() / app.Supervisor() / app.Limits()
  runtime.Supervisor             # Spawn(name, Task) / Stop / Wait / Close
  runtime.Task                   # func(ctx) error
  diag.Diag                      # Code, Title, What, Why, Where, Fix, Remedy, Docs, Severity
  diag.Severity                  # Info|Warning|Error
  http.Ctx                       # request context: JSON, HTML, Param, Bind, ...
  http.Server                    # typed router + middleware chain
  record.Model / record.BaseModel / record.Driver / record.TxDriver
  live.Hub / live.Channel / live.Handle
  jobs.Queue / jobs.Envelope / jobs.Handler / jobs.Retry / jobs.DLQDriver

# ---------- agent-safe vs agent-unsafe operations ----------
agent-safe:
  - ogon --version / --help / explain / inspect / routes list / agent dump
  - ogon new <name> --template minimal|standard|modular --dry-run
  - ogon gen <thing> <name> --dry-run
  - ogon migrate diff / status
  - ogon doctor (no --fix)
  - ogon fmt (no --fix), ogon lint, ogon check
  - ogon test, ogon benchmark
agent-unsafe:
  - ogon new <name> (without --dry-run) writes to disk
  - ogon gen <thing> (without --dry-run) writes files (refuses on unowned files unless --force)
  - ogon migrate run / rollback (mutates the database)
  - ogon migrate create (writes migration files)
  - ogon deploy (builds + pushes + applies to a cloud)
  - ogon infra gen (writes committed infrastructure files)
  - ogon db reset (destructive)
  - ogon update (AST-migrates project source)
  - ogon fmt --fix, ogon lint --fix, ogon doctor --fix
golden-rule: every mutating command supports --dry-run; use it before --yes.
